title: Cost Tracking
description: CPU/memory request totals are shown as a resource-allocation proxy. For actual dollar cost figures, deploy an OpenCost or Kubecost exporter and repoint these panels at its opencost_*/kubecost_* metrics — none is currently deployed in this repo, so treat this dashboard as capacity/allocation tracking until one is added.

options.content:
**CPU/memory request totals are shown as a resource-allocation proxy.** For actual dollar cost figures, deploy an OpenCost or Kubecost exporter and repoint these panels at its `opencost_*`/`kubecost_*` metrics — none is currently deployed in this repo, so treat this dashboard as capacity/allocation tracking until one is added.

All panels below also depend on **kube-state-metrics** being deployed and scraped by Prometheus (not currently a configured scrape job in `monitoring/prometheus.yml`).

panels.title: CPU Request Allocation by Service
panels.description: Resource-allocation proxy, not a dollar cost breakdown. See dashboard description.

panels.description: Resource-allocation proxy, not a dollar cost breakdown. See dashboard description.
